title: Start here — Observation v0.5
summary: Neutral read-only observation protocol/stream/gateway/service shared by Terminal Machine and Virtual Browser. v0.5 adds producer registration, stream discovery, replay, monotonic consumer checkpoints, optional WLU delivery admission and Queue Fabric delivery.
invariants: Observation is read-only evidence transport, not mutation authority.
Semantic observation history is distinct from Queue delivery state.
WLU admission gates delivery only; it cannot rewrite retained observation history.
